description: The internal queue. `Go` takes `Idle -> Work`, whose effects raise `Ping` 1; entering `Work.Inner` raises `Pong`; its `always` enters the final `Work.Finished`, whose entry raises `Ping` 2 before `Work`'s completion is queued. The step works through the queue in the order queued, after every `always`: `Ping` 1, `Pong`, `Ping` 2, each taken by `Work` with an `event` record whose input is `raised`, and only then `Work`'s `done`. `Next`, queued together with `Go`, is taken after the whole step.
